name: yawps
description: YAWPS - Yet Another Windows PHP Switcher

scripts.build:wails: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$env:Path = 'C:\Program Files\Go\bin;C:\Users\eldin\go\bin;' + $env:Path; wails build; if (Test-Path build\bin\yawps.exe) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path dist | Out-Null; Copy-Item build\bin\yawps.exe dist\yawps.exe -Force }"
scripts.build:wails:upx: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$env:Path = 'C:\Program Files\Go\bin;C:\Users\eldin\go\bin;' + $env:Path; wails build -upx; if (Test-Path build\bin\yawps.exe) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path dist | Out-Null; Copy-Item build\bin\yawps.exe dist\yawps.exe -Force }"
scripts.dist:wails: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$env:Path = 'C:\Program Files\Go\bin;C:\Users\eldin\go\bin;' + $env:Path; wails build -upx; if (Test-Path build\bin\yawps.exe) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path dist | Out-Null; Copy-Item build\bin\yawps.exe dist\yawps.exe -Force }"
